IELTS va kundalik suhbat uchun 10 muhim grammatika

Tarjimon yonida tez takrorlash uchun: artikllar, zamonlar, savol tuzilishi va speaking qoliplari.

10 mavzu

01 · Articles: a / an / the

Qolip: a book, an idea, the internet

Misol: I bought a book. The book is useful.

Eslab qoling: a/an — birinchi marta yoki noma’lum narsa; the — ma’lum narsa. Ko‘plik va umumiy ma’noda article ko‘pincha ishlatilmaydi.

02 · Present Simple

Qolip: I/you/we/they work · he/she/it works

Misol: I usually study in the evening.

Speaking uchun: odatlar, faktlar va fikrlarni aytganda ishlating. He/she/it bilan fe’lga -s qo‘shiladi.

03 · Savol va inkor

Qolip: Do you...? · Does she...? · Did they...? / don’t, doesn’t, didn’t

Misol: Does your city have good public transport?

Eslab qoling: does/did kelganda asosiy fe’l oddiy shaklda qoladi: Did you go?, Did you went emas.

04 · Present Continuous

Qolip: am/is/are + verb-ing

Misol: People are spending more time online.

Vazifasi: hozir sodir bo‘layotgan yoki vaqtinchalik jarayonni ko‘rsatadi.

05 · Past Simple

Qolip: subject + V2 / did + V1

Misol: I visited Samarkand last year.

Signal so‘zlar: yesterday, last week, in 2020, two days ago.

06 · Present Perfect

Qolip: have/has + V3

Misol: Technology has changed our lives.

IELTS uchun: tajriba va hozirgi natijani aytishda foydali: I have visited..., This has led to...

07 · Future va reja

Qolip: will + V1 · be going to + V1 · present continuous

Misol: I’m going to improve my English next year.

Farqi: will — tezkor qaror/taxmin; going to — oldindan reja yoki dalilga asoslangan taxmin.

08 · Modallar

Qolip: can, could, should, must, might + V1

Misol: Governments should invest in education.

Speaking uchun: maslahat, imkoniyat, majburiyat va ehtimolni aniq ifodalaydi.

09 · Conditionals

Qolip: If + present, will + V1 · If + past, would + V1

Misol: If cities improve transport, traffic will decrease.

IELTS Writing/Speaking: sabab–natija va faraziy fikrlarni bog‘lashda ishlating.

10 · Fikrni rivojlantirish

Qolip: opinion + reason + example + result

Misol: I believe it is useful because it saves time. For example, online classes are flexible.

Yaxshi javob: Firstly, however, therefore, for instance, as a result kabi bog‘lovchilar bilan fikrni 2–4 gapga kengaytiring.
